newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jardine Intl Motor names Ward as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Intl Motor names Ward as CEO.

text.p: Jardine International Motor Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had appointed Peter Ward as chief executive, effective February 1, succeeding Richard Lee who is approaching retirement age.
The company added that joint managing director Anthony Nightingale would be named chairman on the same date, succeeding Simon Keswick, who will remain a director.
Ward was chairman and chief executive of Cunard Line Ltd, prior to which he had 30 years experience in the motor industry, Jardine International Motors said in a statement.
Lee will be appointed chairman of Zung Fu, the company's principal subsidiary, and will continue to concentrate on the development of the China and Hong Kong markets, it said.
The appointments are in preparation for the next phase of the company's growth and creates a clear path for management succession, it said.
The company is a member of the Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd group.
